# Sources and snapshot provenance

Authoritative live sources for the supported Agent Skills guidance:

- [Agent Skills Specification](https://agentskills.io/specification)
- [Agent Skills source repository](https://github.com/agentskills/agentskills)
- [Agent Plugins Specification v1.0.0](https://agent-plugins.org/specification) (defines how skills are discovered inside a portable plugin)
- [GitHub Copilot agent skills](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/about-agent-skills)

## Bundled snapshot

The files in `raw/` are exact upstream copies pinned to agentskills/agentskills commit `69ef37e9424c0a7ea9dd2293b559e43ec8176379`:

| File | Upstream path | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `raw/specification.mdx` | `docs/specification.mdx` | `b9079c0c10b7930e8c6a20ff2bc10cda2a3343c55185120e3f1116a1a529b220` |
| `raw/LICENSE.txt` | `LICENSE` | `993da3f8d330d69108e521636555f7783ef81d46b904394c59ec5ff651331fe5` |

Use the live specification when checking for upstream changes. Use the bundled snapshot for reproducible review of MetaFlow's supported baseline. The upstream repository states that specification files are Apache 2.0 and documentation is CC BY 4.0; the bundled repository license is included beside the snapshot.
